claims.claim: Pension Credit is a qualifying benefit for the Warm Home Discount Scheme.
claims.quote: The qualifying means-tested benefits are: Universal Credit Housing Benefit income-related Employment and Support Allowance (ESA) Pension Credit
claims.note: The source lists Pension Credit among the qualifying benefits.

claims.claim: For eligible recipients of Pension Credit, the discount is usually applied automatically.
claims.quote: You’ll get the discount automatically if you or your partner: get Pension Credit
claims.note: The source says recipients of Pension Credit get the discount automatically.
